data.name: Harishchandra
data.gender_notes: Harishchandra is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Harishchandra is a name of Vishnu, the Hindu god of truth, dharma, and morality. The name is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Harish’ (having God as the giver) and ‘Chandra’ (moon). The name Harishchandra carries the meaning “God of Truth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Harishchandra usually hope their child will grow to embody god of truth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Harishchandra represents the inner truth and moral compass that guides us through life. It is a reminder to always speak the truth, even when it is difficult or inconvenient.
data.etymology: Harishchandra belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Truth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Harishchandra total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: Harishchandra is an iconic name in Indian mythology and has been revered for centuries. The tale of King Harishchandra, who was devoted to truth and upheld it at all costs, is among the most popular and enduring stories of the Hindu tradition. This name invokes a sense of duty, honesty, and righteousness, and serves as an inspiration for many in Indian society.
data.spiritual_significance: Harishchandra represents the embodiment of truth and fearlessness. In Hinduism, Harishchandra's soul is considered purified after his life and he attained moksha or salvation. The name is associated with the purest and highest spiritual aspirations, and imparts a sense of spiritual strength and courage to those who bear it.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Harishchandra symbolizes truth and righteousness. Named after Lord Vishnu, who is the embodiment of truth, Harishchandra's life is a testament to the power of honesty and integrity. Despite facing numerous trials, he remained steadfast in his commitment to truth, ultimately earning divine blessings and peace.

historical_references.reference: Harishchandra was a legendary king in Hindu mythology, who is known for his truthfulness and honesty.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Harishchandra remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.
